source.registered_copies: registered_assets/a11 (full notebook + rules + cell extracts; trust-anchored SHAs in d3_stage.TRUSTED_SOURCES)

contract.relation: C(g r) = D(M) C(r) D(M)^T on the frozen real basis (t1_engine.load_cov_full real basis; D(M) from t2b2_bridge quadrature: (YQ*WQ)^T Ymat(DIRS @ M))
contract.clone_x0: x0_H1 = M_CT b - T_CT (registered hypothesis H1; H2 = M_CT b + T_CT is the discriminating alternative, not the clone)
contract.metric: rel(C1, target) = ||C1 - target||_F / ||target||_F, target = D(M) C0 D(M)^T, C0 = base covariance, C1 = INDEPENDENTLY generated clone covariance; diagnostics rel_off (off-diagonal), rel_white (diagonal-whitened)
contract.direction: generated clone C1 compared to the transformed base; never D C0 D^T stored as the clone's generated value

tolerance.source: A11 R5: match rel < 1e-5 (TOL_MATCH); discriminate rel > 1e-2 (TOL_DISCR)

not_used.reason: same-covariance regeneration tolerance of the D-1 A11 cross-check; not a physical clone tolerance

contract.basis: both covariances loaded with the frozen t1_engine real-basis transform (21x21 real); M is the spatial 3x3 deck matrix; D(M) is its 21x21 representation

status_semantics.PC1_PENDING: not yet compared (covariances may be ungenerated or generated; no PC-1 evaluation has been made)
status_semantics.PC1_PASS: rel < 1e-5 for every required action of the configuration
status_semantics.PC1_FAIL: any required action rel >= 1e-5 (asset-layer failure; formal consumption forbidden; NOT converted to position-unresolved / UNKNOWN; no prior renormalisation; no 3-position fallback)

provenance_route.note: which verified route supplied the bytes; excluded from the payload SHA (the bytes are identical by SHA)

counts.note: one case per (configuration, required action); E8 has two actions; E1 excluded (homogeneous); first-wave bases: 27 required (E2/E7/E8 anchors), verified for reuse only when the D-1 registry is bound (draft: 0); the 3 E1 D-1 covariances are kept but not clone-tested
